items.question: Does the camera maintain a consistent downward-looking viewpoint of the dark gray bench and petri dishes for the entire video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，摄像机是否保持俯视深灰色实验台和培养皿的、一致的视角？

items.question: Does the petri dish containing yellow seeds remain a single, identifiable dish throughout the video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，装有黄色种子的培养皿是否始终是单个、可辨识的培养皿？

items.question: Does the petri dish containing mixed yellow and brown seeds remain a single, identifiable dish throughout the video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，装有黄棕色混合种子的培养皿是否始终是单个、可辨识的培养皿？

items.question: Does the empty petri dish that receives TTC solution remain a single, identifiable dish throughout the video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，将接收 TTC 溶液的空培养皿是否始终是单个、可辨识的培养皿？

items.question: Do the two empty petri dishes remain visually distinct from each other throughout the video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，两个空培养皿在视觉上是否始终彼此区分、互不相同？

items.question: Is TTC solution visibly poured into the dish containing yellow seeds?
items.question_zh: 是否可见地将 TTC 溶液倒入装有黄色种子的培养皿中？

items.question: Is TTC solution visibly poured into the dish containing mixed yellow and brown seeds?
items.question_zh: 是否可见地将 TTC 溶液倒入装有黄棕色混合种子的培养皿中？

items.question: Is TTC solution visibly poured into one of the empty petri dishes?
items.question_zh: 是否可见地将 TTC 溶液倒入其中一个空培养皿中？

items.question: Does the pour into the yellow-seed dish occur before the pour into the mixed-seed dish?
items.question_zh: 倒入黄色种子培养皿是否先于倒入混合种子培养皿而发生？

items.question: Does the pour into the mixed-seed dish occur before the pour into the empty petri dish?
items.question_zh: 倒入混合种子培养皿是否先于倒入空培养皿而发生？

items.question: After the pour, does the yellow-seed dish contain a visible pool of amber TTC solution?
items.question_zh: 倒入之后，黄色种子培养皿中是否可见一汪琥珀色的 TTC 溶液？

items.question: After the pour, does the mixed-seed dish contain a visible pool of amber TTC solution?
items.question_zh: 倒入之后，混合种子培养皿中是否可见一汪琥珀色的 TTC 溶液？

items.question: After the pour, does the targeted empty petri dish contain a visible pool of amber TTC solution?
items.question_zh: 倒入之后，目标空培养皿中是否可见一汪琥珀色的 TTC 溶液？

items.question: Does the other empty petri dish remain without any visible TTC solution throughout the video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，另一个空培养皿是否始终没有任何可见的 TTC 溶液？

items.question: Does the brown-seed dish remain without any visible TTC solution throughout the video?
items.question_zh: 在整个视频中，装有棕色种子的培养皿是否始终没有任何可见的 TTC 溶液？

items.question: Does the poured TTC solution remain inside the dishes without passing through the dish material or the bench surface?
items.question_zh: 倒入的 TTC 溶液是否始终留在培养皿内，不穿过培养皿的材料或实验台表面？

items.question: Does the amber TTC solution avoid spilling onto the laboratory bench or outside the petri dishes during the entire procedure?
items.question_zh: 在整个操作过程中，琥珀色 TTC 溶液是否避免洒到实验台上或培养皿外面？
